effects.does: Opens the AI‑generated RFP helper and sends the project line items to the AI service.
effects.affects: calls `/ask_ai_chats/rfp_questions` and stores the returned AI summary in `claraSummary`.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that the Clara summary panel appears with generated text.

effects.does: Opens the attachments drawer so the buyer can upload files for the event.
effects.check: Click the button and confirm that a file‑upload drawer appears.

effects.does: Opens the Terms & Conditions editor where the buyer can type or paste clauses.
effects.check: Click the button and verify that a T&C text area is displayed.

effects.does: Opens the Manage Line Items modal to add, edit or delete line items.
effects.affects: creates/updates the `line_items` array for the project.
effects.check: Click the button and ensure a line‑item table with Add/Edit controls appears.

effects.does: Attempts to save the current project as a draft, but the control is disabled.
effects.check: Hover over the button and verify the tooltip "Please choose a template and add a product".

effects.does: Validates required fields and, if all checks pass, publishes the event (creates stages and makes them active).
effects.affects: sends a POST/PATCH with `status:"active"` and creates the event stages.
effects.leadsTo: event is created and the UI redirects to the new event page.
effects.check: Click Publish with a title, template and at least one line item; verify the event appears in the Events list.

effects.does: Toggles the auction to use a lot‑based ranking strategy.
effects.affects: `strategy` is set to `rank` and `closingOn` to `lot_based` in the auction configuration.
effects.check: Toggle the button and inspect the payload; it should contain `strategy:"rank"` and `closingOn:"lot_based"`.

effects.does: Opens the template selector drawer; choosing a template replaces the current template and may reset data.
effects.affects: `templateUuid` is set; existing line items, savings, currencies and participants may be cleared.
effects.leadsTo: drawer opens; after selection the screen refreshes with the new template.
effects.check: Open the selector, pick a different template and confirm a confirmation dialog appears warning about data reset.

effects.does: Opens the Participants drawer to add vendor companies to the event.
effects.affects: populates `audience_company_uuids` with the selected vendor IDs.
effects.check: Click the button and verify a searchable list of companies appears.

effects.does: Button is disabled because savings can only be configured after a template with savings enabled is selected.
effects.check: Hover and confirm tooltip "Please choose a template and add a product".

effects.does: Button is disabled because T&C editing requires a selected template and at least one line item.
effects.check: Hover and verify the same tooltip as other disabled footer buttons.

effects.does: Button is disabled because scheduling a custom duration requires a template to be chosen first.
effects.check: Hover and verify tooltip "Please select template for <stage title>".

effects.does: Opens a feedback dialog where the buyer can submit comments about the creation flow.
effects.affects: creates a feedback record (not part of the event payload).
effects.check: Click the button and ensure a modal with a textarea and Submit button appears.

effects.does: Navigates to the Tickets page for the current user.
effects.check: Click the button and verify the URL changes to `/tickets` and the tickets list loads.

effects.does: Selects the Auction tab, showing auction‑specific configuration options.
effects.affects: sets the UI mode to `auction`; no data change.
effects.leadsTo: stays here with Auction tab content displayed
effects.check: Verify the tab is highlighted and auction fields become visible.

effects.does: Navigates to the main Events list view.
effects.check: Click the link and confirm the URL changes to `/events` and the list loads.

effects.does: Navigates to the Tickets view (duplicate of control 14).
effects.check: Click the link and verify the Tickets page opens.

effects.control: Enter the title of the project
effects.does: Accepts user input and stores it as the project title.
effects.check: Enter text, submit the form, and verify the request body contains the entered title.

effects.control: Search vendors you want to add
effects.does: Provides a searchable dropdown to add vendors, but is disabled until a template is selected.
effects.check: Hover and confirm tooltip "Please select template for <stage title>" and that the control cannot be opened.
